body.name: F
body.def: Local notation is defined by \(\mathcal F_{i,0}=\mathbb G_{(i-1)m}\) and \(\mathcal F_{i,j}=\mathbb G_{o(i,j)}\) for \(j\in J\); every pre-cell conditional law is nevertheless taken with respect to \(\mathbb G_{o(i,j)-1}\).
body.role: Explicit row baselines and local history notation.
